artifact_validation.method: Read every existing regular file under both immutable run roots, compute SHA-256 over exact bytes, parse every JSON artifact, and verify declared request, response, design-document, plan-artifact, stage-log, call-count, and status cross-links.

retrieval_stage_observations.scope: observed_pre-generation retrieval evidence; no retrieval artifacts were changed
retrieval_stage_observations.interpretation_limit: Retrieval preparation and leakage controls were validated, but the run does not establish that the retrieved context improved or harmed generated-code semantics because semantic evaluation was never reached.

design_document_observations.scope: read-only observation; the design document was neither corrected nor supplemented
observations: The document records the class responsibility, most public interface groups, private state, dependencies, and proposed invariants.
It does not enumerate every overload preserved by the fixed scaffold, including the Node-key operator[] and remove overloads.
It contains behavioral and invariant assertions that were not independently validated by this run, including an undefined-behavior statement and a claimed relationship between m_isValid and m_pNode.
No design-document audit finding was added to or used to enrich the code-regeneration prompt.
design_document_observations.causal_limit: The observed design-document omissions or assertions cannot be classified as a build or semantic failure cause because structural validation stopped the run before compilation.

code_regeneration_observations.response_ending_observation: The response ended after the m_pNode field declaration and did not contain the closing brace for class YAML::Node.

evidence: done_reason was stop rather than length
output_length_assessment.conclusion: The stored response was not terminated by the configured output-token ceiling.

structural_validation_failure.error: Matching closing brace was not found
structural_validation_failure.validator_outcome: The outer-fence/structural stage found the target class opening brace but could not find its matching closing brace.
structural_validation_failure.manual_repair_policy: Adding the missing brace would be a prohibited manual repair. It was not performed and must not be performed for this immutable run.

source_backup.reason: structural validation failed before the original-source backup step

restoration.reason: restoration was unnecessary because source replacement never occurred

next_pilot_options.decision_criterion: whether this pilot sufficiently validated the pipeline mechanics, not which option is more likely to produce a passing generated implementation

option_a.label: execute_next_frozen_target_unchanged
option_a.description: Execute the next already-frozen yaml-cpp target under the unchanged protocol.
advantages: Preserves direct protocol comparability across frozen targets.
Avoids introducing a new mechanism after observing the first target outcome.
Provides an independent observation of whether the structural failure recurs on a different frozen target.
disadvantages: The source-replacement, configure, build, direct-test, full-test, and restoration mechanics may remain unvalidated if the next output also fails structural validation.
Consumes another frozen target while a material portion of the execution pipeline has never been exercised.
A second target outcome would mix treatment behavior with unresolved pipeline-mechanics uncertainty.

option_b.label: separate_mechanics_sensitivity_pilot
option_b.description: Create a separately identified mechanics/sensitivity pilot with a new run ID and an explicit protocol revision; do not treat it as a retry or replacement for run01.
advantages: Separates pipeline-mechanics validation from the immutable treatment outcome.
Allows predeclared study of structural-output sensitivity and the downstream replacement/build/test/restoration path under a separately labeled protocol.
Preserves run01 as an unmodified failure while reducing uncertainty about whether later failures occur before or after the pipeline mechanics are exercised.
disadvantages: Results are not directly interchangeable with unchanged-protocol runs.
A protocol revision introduces a new experimental factor that must be documented and analyzed separately.
Requires additional preparation and cannot be used to reclassify, repair, or supersede run01.

next_pilot_options.rationale: The current pilot validated retrieval preparation, prompt isolation, one-shot reservation/contact, evidence capture, and rejection before unsafe source mutation. It did not validate source replacement, configure/build, direct/full tests, restoration after replacement, or semantic evaluation. Therefore pipeline mechanics are not sufficiently validated to spend the next frozen target solely as an unchanged-protocol continuation. Option B is recommended to resolve that mechanics uncertainty under a new identity and protocol revision, not because it is expected to make generated code pass.
